mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary regime, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) in periods where FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly acceleration in real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% signals improved corporate earnings prospects, driving higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No statistically significant positive excess return (vs. risk-free) in periods where GDPC1 > 2% quarterly.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for two consecutive months indicates a tightening labor market, which raises wage pressures and inflation expectations, ultimately leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary tightening follows.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly negative during periods when UNRATE < 4% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly negative during periods of four consecutive monthly INDPRO declines below the 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated decline in both personal consumption expenditures proxy (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) below their respective 6-month averages signals a broad-based weakening in demand, which depresses earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS and HOUST are below their 6-month averages for at least one month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above their 12-month averages signals a monetary tightening accompanied by rising inflation, creating a stagflationary environment that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed their 12-month averages concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average for five consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive excess return in S&P 500 20-day horizon during periods of five consecutive months with PAYEMS above its 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the real savings rate proxy (RSAFS/GDPC1) below its 10-year average for six consecutive months signals a secular weakening in national saving, which reduces capital formation and long-term growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly negative during periods when the real savings rate proxy is persistently below its 10-year average for six months.
